scientific_integrity: A complete, exactly reproducible finite classification and a structural scalar-orbit argument support the claimed counts; no publication, authorship, independent validation or external certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: The exact 21/29 spectrum concerns only the seventh-power witness coloring of binary three-spaces in a six-space; it does not optimize the chromatic number or classify other colorings and does not extrapolate to other extension degrees. The Moore determinant and witness-coloring construction are established prior work. Independent audit is not performed.
title: Two-level fiber spectrum of the seventh-power Grassmann coloring
